title: Checkout restricted to card and PayPay, and pausing a subscription, with stripe-node 23
notes: stripe-node 23.0.0 (2026-09-30) removed payment_method_types from Checkout.SessionCreateParams in favour of allowed_payment_method_types, and added subscriptions.pause (POST /v1/subscriptions/:id/pause with invoicing_behavior). A model coding from memory reaches for payment_method_types (a type error now) and pauses with subscriptions.update plus pause_collection (compiles, but hits the wrong endpoint). The installed types state both answers: node_modules/stripe/cjs/resources/Checkout/Sessions.d.ts:2153 contrasts allowed_payment_method_types with payment_method_types, node_modules/stripe/cjs/resources/Subscriptions.d.ts:86 documents subscriptions.pause, and node_modules/stripe/cjs/resources/Subscriptions.d.ts:3014 says invoicing_behavior defaults to pending_invoice_item (so the check accepts the default as well as the explicit value). node_modules/stripe/CHANGELOG.md:147 and :168 list both additions.
